Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally raise a concern regarding an incident involving [bhuvnesh sir ], who made inappropriate and disrespectful comments about Hinduism, specifically targeting Lord Shiva and Lord Ganesha.

Such remarks are deeply hurtful to the sentiments of those who follow the Hindu faith and promote religious intolerance. As an educational institution/professional environment, we expect mutual respect for all religions and beliefs.

I kindly request you to look into this matter seriously and take appropriate action to ensure that such behavior is not repeated in the future. It is important that we maintain a respectful and inclusive atmosphere for everyone.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.
